book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Probability & Statistics 1
book.author: Dean Chalmers
book.policy: Book informs concepts and teaching structure; notes, numerical examples and short checks are independently written. No textbook exercises or artwork are copied.

syllabus.current_document: 2026–2027; section 5.5 verified against the official URL
syllabus.scope: Normal continuous models, probabilities, quantiles, parameter inference and normal approximation to a binomial with continuity correction. Selected cross-links to sections 5.1, 5.3 and 5.4. No S2 linear-combination or sampling-distribution formula is assumed.
syllabus.version_caution: Retrievals returned differing cover-version labels (parsed text and page image). No unqualified version number is asserted here. Section 5.5 content was checked directly in both examination-year documents.

conventions.student: Give numerical probabilities and non-integer quantities to 3 significant figures unless another form is requested. Show all standardisation and working. Use unrounded intermediate probabilities. Standard-normal tables or a calculator may be used.
conventions.rounding: Correct table-based solutions are acceptable; the automated specification uses full-precision calculation and flags table-rounding discrepancies for manual review.
conventions.binomial_approximation: Both np>5 and n(1−p)>5 are checked wherever the normal approximation is used. Inverse count/sample-size answers are explicitly approximation-based.

sourceCheckSpecifications: Retained privately as specifications only; written explanations, model assumptions, integer bounds, stopped histories and method marks use the existing manual/teacher workflow.
